integrity: The mathematical identity and strict sign classification are analytically proved and reproduced with symbolic arithmetic; finite regression checks are not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Exact for one peer step, perfect prediction, homogeneous peer susceptibility on a three-agent triangle, innate vector (1,0,0), platform beta=(b,z,0); the one/two-agent minimality uses the same model class. No arbitrary-network law, empirical prediction or independent novelty validation.
title: A three-agent threshold for nonmonotone opinion homogenization under heterogeneous platform susceptibility
